runs.text: THE DARK ELEMENT Feat.Anette Olzon & Jani Liimatainen

NEW ALBUM "The Legend Of The Six Kings" OUT October 02 on Napalm Records

Formed in 2017, FROZEN CROWN has garnered significant media exposure with their previous four albums and built a dedicated following with their mixture of power metal, old-school speed and heavy metal. During its short lifespan, the relentless band has performed at several festivals like Sabaton Open Air, Metal Fest Plzen and Rock Imperium Festival, headlined two Japanese tours and followed extensive European touring with significant bands such as Dragonforce and Nanowar Of Steel – dubbed by the tour with U.D.O. in 2023. Joined by their newest member, 18-year-old guitar prodigy Alessia Lanzone, the band's characteristic sound has been expanded by her skills, adding depth and complexity to their performances.
The new album "War Hearts", out October 18, 2024. This marks the band’s fifth album in their seven-year career and their first as a six-piece band, capturing the essence of FROZEN CROWN's dynamic sound brimming with powerful riffs, unforgettable melodies, and raw energy.
